initial-dialogue.npc: I'm fine, I'm fine. Just a scratch.

initial-dialogue.player: If you're sure. Who are you?
That hat you're wearing doesn't look like it comes from around here?

initial-dialogue.npc: It was a present. My employer thought it would suit me. I'm not sure it does, though it does keep the sun off very well.
Simon Templeton. He's an archaeologist. I worked as an assistant for him, though I haven't seen him since the plague business started, so I work for myself now.

initial-dialogue.player: I see. So what have you been up to?

initial-dialogue.npc: Simon suggested that there might be riches to be found in this pyramid.
All I've found so far are injuries though.

initial-dialogue.text: If the player has never played the Pyramid Plunder minigame:

steps.player: Interesting... What can you tell me about this pyramid?

steps.npc: Well, I'm not sure. It's called Jalsavrah apparently. It's a strange place.
First of all, there's something odd about the doors. There's four of them, but three of them lead to an empty tomb.
The other one is guarded by something, and whatever it is, it doesn't like visitors.
The thing is, the doors seem to change around sometimes. It's all quite confusing.

steps.player: What's this thing guarding one of them.

steps.npc: I think it might be a mummy. It's not very friendly, but it does allow you to enter some of the rooms in the tomb. They are dangerous though.

steps.player: Well I'm not afraid of a little danger.

steps.npc: Are you sure? The place is full of poisonous snakes and scarabs along with some rather nasty mummies as well. You could die in there.
I managed to get into one room, but the next room was harder. My lockpicking skills weren't good enough. Maybe I should have taken a lockpick.

steps.player: It all sounds like fun to me. So, is there anything valuable in there?

steps.npc: There are lots of artefacts that you should be able to sell to a legitimate trader...
Of course. He's as 'legitimate' as you can get.

steps.player: Is there anything else of value in there?

steps.npc: I've heard a rumour that there is an ancient magic sceptre somewhere inside.

steps.player: Ah, now you've piqued my interest. What do you know about this sceptre?

steps.npc: Not a lot. It's apparently made of gold and covered in jewels. It's supposed to have some magical powers as well.

steps.player: Magical powers? This sounds good. What are they?

steps.npc: I'll let you know when I find it!

steps.player: Not if I find it first!

steps.npc: Hey! if you find it, I deserve a share of the profits! You wouldn't have known it existed without my help.

initial-dialogue.text: If the player has played the Pyramid Plunder minigame:

steps.player: Yes, it's an odd place, isn't it?

steps.npc: You've been inside? Did you find anything?
Well if you do, I'd appreciate a share of any profits.

initial-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.npc: Oh, hello. Any luck in the pyramid? I'd appreciate a cut of anything you find.

initial-dialogue-subsequent-dialogue.player: Right... I'll be sure to let you know if I come across anything good...

using-items-on-him-plundered-artefacts.text: You show the artefact to Tarik.

using-items-on-him-plundered-artefacts.npc: Ohh... That looks nice. I'm looking forward to my cut.

using-items-on-him-plundered-artefacts.player: Ah, yes... I'll bring it round later.

using-items-on-him-pharaoh-s-sceptre.text: You show the sceptre to Tarik.

using-items-on-him-pharaoh-s-sceptre.player: Hey, look at this sceptre I found!

using-items-on-him-pharaoh-s-sceptre.npc: Wow! It looks very valuable. What's my share?

using-items-on-him-pharaoh-s-sceptre.player: Well given the work I had to go through to get it, I think I earned it all by myself.

using-items-on-him-pharaoh-s-sceptre.npc: Hey, that's not fair. I told you about this pyramid!

using-items-on-him-pharaoh-s-sceptre.player: The world is a harsh place. Live and learn.
